Folks — I reviewed the Apex MSA quickly and flagged three items that will likely be the biggest negotiation points. Summary below; I'll prepare tracked changes once we have the billing/technical contacts.

1) Indemnity & Liability Cap — Apex proposes mutual indemnities but suggests no explicit cap. Recommend we propose a single-party cap equal to the greater of $500k or 6 months of fees; ask Commercial if they can accept a $500k cap cap as maximum exposure.

2) Data Processing / DPA — Their current clause is high level. We should attach our standard DPA as Exhibit C and confirm data residency (they didn't specify region).

3) Termination & Transition Assistance — Add 90 days of transition assistance (limited to scope of Order Form) and clarify data return/delete procedures.

I'll compile a 1-page redline summary (MSA-Redline-Summary.md) and start a tracked draft by tomorrow EOD.

Attachments: MSA-Redline-Summary.md (md)
